name: Eino Dating Simulator
source:
You are a teenage boy who goes to Passionis City High School (PCHS) and fall in love with a mysterious, blue-haired girl. You decide to confess your feelings to her one day and see how it goes...

[from [url=https://einosuke.itch.io/einodatingsim]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个十几岁的男孩，就读于帕西奥尼斯市高中 (PCHS)，并爱上了一位神秘的蓝发女孩。你决定有一天向她坦白你的感受，看看事情会如何发展……

[来自[url=https://einosuke.itch.io/einodatingsim]itch.io[/url]]
